# Offline historical timeline

The event text in events.db is excerpted from the English Wikipedia June 2026 Kiwix archive, including year articles, Timeline of prehistory and Timeline of ancient history. The article column identifies each source. For a given article, visit https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TITLE and use “View history” for contributors. Build-history-index.py extracts event sections, removes markup and reference markers, omits undated and unparsed early entries and assigns approximate coordinates to chronology ranges. Wikipedia contributors’ text and the adapted compilation are distributed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The archive predates this timeline. Consult individual articles and their references for corrections, reuse exceptions and alternative accounts.

The guided entries and interpretation notes are editorial summaries. Sources include the corresponding Wikipedia articles and [Smithsonian Human Origins](https://humanorigins.si.edu/evidence/human-fossils/species/homo-sapiens), [White Sands National Park](https://www.nps.gov/whsa/learn/nature/fossilized-footprints.htm), and [Moreno-Mayar et al., Nature (2024)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07881-4).
